mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID, LOGIN_ID, USER_NAME, COMPANY_ID, SITE_ID, DEPT_ID, PASSWORD_HASH, AUTH_TYPE, USER_STATUS, FAILED_LOGIN_COUNT, LOCKED_UNTIL, PASSWORD_CHANGED_AT, MUST_CHANGE_PASSWORD_YN, USE_YN FROM S2C_USER WHERE UPPER(LOGIN_ID) = UPPER(#{loginId})

SELECT DISTINCT R.ROLE_CODE FROM S2C_USER_ROLE UR JOIN S2C_ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE UR.USER_ID = #{userId} AND UR.USE_YN = 'Y' AND R.USE_YN = 'Y' AND UR.VALID_FROM <= SYSDATE AND ( UR.VALID_TO IS NULL OR UR.VALID_TO >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) ) ORDER BY R.ROLE_CODE
SELECT MENU_ID, PARENT_MENU_ID, MENU_CODE, MENU_NAME, MENU_LEVEL, MENU_TYPE, SCREEN_ID, FORM_PATH, ICON_NAME, SORT_ORDER FROM S2C_MENU WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY MENU_LEVEL, SORT_ORDER, MENU_ID

SELECT A.MENU_ID, A.AUTH_LEVEL, A.CAN_EXCEL, A.CAN_APPROVE, A.CAN_CLOSE, A.CAN_COST_VIEW, A.DATA_SCOPE FROM S2C_USER_ROLE UR JOIN S2C_ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID JOIN S2C_ROLE_MENU_AUTH A ON A.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE UR.USER_ID = #{userId} AND UR.USE_YN = 'Y' AND R.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND UR.VALID_FROM <= SYSDATE AND ( UR.VALID_TO IS NULL OR UR.VALID_TO >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) )

SELECT MENU_ID, AUTH_LEVEL, CAN_EXCEL, CAN_APPROVE, CAN_CLOSE, CAN_COST_VIEW, DATA_SCOPE FROM ( SELECT UMA.MENU_ID, UMA.AUTH_LEVEL, UMA.CAN_EXCEL, UMA.CAN_APPROVE, UMA.CAN_CLOSE, UMA.CAN_COST_VIEW, UMA.DATA_SCOPE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY UMA.MENU_ID ORDER BY UMA.VALID_FROM DESC, UMA.USER_MENU_AUTH_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM S2C_USER_MENU_AUTH UMA WHERE UMA.USER_ID = #{userId} AND UMA.USE_YN = 'Y' AND UMA.VALID_FROM <= SYSDATE AND ( UMA.VALID_TO IS NULL OR UMA.VALID_TO >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) ) WHERE RN = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE S2C_USER SET USER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE', FAILED_LOGIN_COUNT = 0, LOCKED_UNTIL = NULL, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATED_BY = 'AUTH' WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} AND USER_STATUS = 'LOCKED' AND LOCKED_UNTIL IS NOT NULL AND LOCKED_UNTIL <= SYSTIMESTAMP
UPDATE S2C_USER SET FAILED_LOGIN_COUNT = 0, USER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE', LOCKED_UNTIL = NULL, LAST_LOGIN_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATED_BY = 'AUTH' WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE S2C_USER SET PASSWORD_HASH = #{passwordHash}, PASSWORD_CHANGED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, MUST_CHANGE_PASSWORD_YN = 'N', UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy} WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
